purpose: Let a zero-human DRAFT cross capture evidence on machine-verifiable proxy media, without ever letting proxy media be mistaken for a human performance.
what_it_asserts: A machine-generated presenter and narration substitute exists, its bytes are real and verifiable, and it covers the approved script well enough for rough-cut assembly and human review to proceed.
what_it_does_not_assert: that PRODUCTION capture requirements are satisfied
that a later real capture is unnecessary
never: reuse the human capture approval marker vocabulary (Manual approval, Capture approval, Capture evidence approval, Rough-cut assembly approval)
record proxy media in takes-log.md as though it were a physical take
relabel synthetic media as real capture
satisfy this disposition with placeholder, dummy, smoke-test or zero-byte media
distinguishable_forever: PROXY_CAPTURE_READY and REAL_CAPTURE_CONFIRMED are separate semantic classes and neither is derivable from the other. A run's history must always show which one it crossed.

required_fields.run_id: the package run this evidence belongs to
required_fields.story: project_id, version_id and content_hash of the approved Story the delivery was generated from
required_fields.produced_by: the agent that generated it; expected generation_supervisor
required_fields.delivery_units: one entry per covered script beat, each carrying beat reference, media path, media sha256, duration_seconds and generation provenance (engine, model, settings)
required_fields.narration_audio: path, sha256, duration_seconds — the synthetic voice bytes
required_fields.presenter_visual: path, sha256, duration_seconds — the proxy presenter or avatar bytes
required_fields.coverage: required_beats, covered_beats, and any beat deliberately carrying no proxy delivery with its reason
required_fields.technical_validation: media bytes verified to exist, be non-empty, and match their recorded hash and duration

reuse_rather_than_reinvent.media_byte_verification: presenter-take-manifest.js#verifyMediaBytes already verifies media existence and hashes; the proxy verifier should use the same primitive rather than a parallel one
reuse_rather_than_reinvent.evidence_shape: the AUDIO_RENDER QC adapter already validates audio evidence as state + production_mix_sha256 + duration_seconds; PROXY_CAPTURE_READY mirrors that shape deliberately
reuse_rather_than_reinvent.qc_consumption: qc-director.js consumes typed evidence classes through adapters; PROXY_CAPTURE_READY should become one more adapter, not a new evaluator

needed: a synthetic narration producer that turns approved script beats into real audio bytes
a proxy presenter visual producer (avatar, stickman or equivalent) that produces real video bytes
a synthetic delivery manifest binding those assets to canonical Story beats with provenance

verified_absent.tts: searched *.js, *.json, *.md, *.py and *.sh for tts, text-to-speech, minimax, elevenlabs, piper, coqui, espeak, kokoro, xtts and bark. The only MiniMax integration is score-engine/adapters/minimax-caption-reference.js, which carries zero voice tokens and is music-caption work. Scorecraft's narration references duck music UNDER narration; they consume speech rather than produce it.
verified_absent.avatar: searched for avatar, talking-head, stickman, proxy presenter, synthetic presenter, generated host, digital human, lip-sync, wav2lip, sadtalker, heygen and d-id. Every hit is prose: a workflow-wizard checklist item, topic-scout requiredVisuals entries, and one server-side text classifier. No producer.
verified_absent.presenter_a_roll: PRESENTER_A_ROLL is absent from visual-plan-prompt-adapter PROMPT_MEDIA by design, not by omission: edit-plan.js maps it to the PRESENTER_CAPTURE source class alongside SCREEN_CAPTURE and ARCHIVAL_EXTERNAL. Those media types are captured or sourced, never generated. Removing the exclusion would not create a producer; it would only let the system claim one exists.

until_the_producer_exists: gate 8 in DRAFT is honestly BLOCKED on a missing producer. It is NOT blocked on Mikko, and the projection must not claim a human is needed in a zero-human draft.
